value.title: Quiet-pane replay is bounded freshness, not screen identity

sections.name: body
sections.value:
PR #313 round 1 reviewed at 8dd610594a1194320106f15233242e8764870b35: pass-with-notes, no normal-use blocker. The observer replays through unchanged decide; send and owned-input submission still take fresh captures; last.at advances only on capture. Unknown/PendingClear never replay.

Quiet tap + unchanged cursor is bounded freshness, not screen identity. tmux 3.6a resizes/reflows and respawns its base screen independently of PTY bytes. A repaired tracked pipe keeps the cached capture; tap trimming already admits losing one write. Backstop bounds these cases at the next scheduled pass after 30 seconds, not a hard real-time deadline. capture-pane without -M and cursor_x/y both use the base screen: copy-mode display is not the captured grid. Fresh capture/list errors do not necessarily mark gate uncertainty, unlike Unrecognized results. None removes the independent fresh typing boundary.

Exact-head CI JUnit artifact 14699755702 (successful job 136785776994, run 44884185946) proves all 18 observer tests passed. Independently inspected coder M1-M6 failure logs; pane_observer.rs, interaction.rs and fakes.rs are byte-identical to receipt head 587fe438. No reviewer mutant was executed. The exact-head local rerun has 18 passed; earlier full macOS lib run had two tmux teardown failures and is not green proof.

Counters wrap modulo 2^64; snapshots are not cross-field atomic; captures count successful results, active_us is wall time. Quiet backstop rate is N/30 seconds averaged, not a burst cap. Unknown panes remain N/0.6 captures/s. AFTER measurements stay with performance post-deploy.

magicWand / INS-001: a regression that runs the observer after a fresh injection changes gate content would defend shared-tap cache invalidation explicitly; geometry/reattach cases should be described as bounded freshness. CONF-001 (annoying): detached, C25-limited boot prescribes worktree-deps despite CI-only TS proof. Suggest review-mode guidance rather than dependency linking. Both kept for owner disposition, not product edits in a review.

Local boot NOT-READY; quick checks exit 1 from missing/wrong TS tooling, with native/SDK/skill sensors passing. Full gate attempt stopped while queued behind another seat's shared-build lock; no installs, links, bounce, product changes or foreign process teardown. Exact-head freeze FINAL and diff --check pass. Holding reviewer/313 until merge.
